tail_census_definitions.denominator_units: every (rbg,ue) entry in the ENV-side close_rbg btx map (IN_ENV guard around _sanitize_and_create_post_rzf) = 738,564 new units across 3 schedulers x 8 seeds x episode_len 1000
tail_census_definitions.over_cap: b > btx_cap + 1e-9 with btx_cap recomputed on the FINAL group (C = beta_m * M; M = raw beta-free one-slot MI)
tail_census_definitions.induced_first_nack: btx_cap - 1e-6 <= actual_MI(h_true, W(h_hat)) < b - 1e-6, matching the ACK rule i_acc >= b_tx - 1e-6
tail_census_definitions.scope_limit: baseline traces only; NOT the live PPO pilot's own actions; ACK-flip equivalence only -- corrected-trajectory (reward/completion/EWMA/obs) equivalence NOT tested
tail_census_definitions.window_math: with ACK tolerance tau=1e-6 (ACK iff i_acc >= B_tx - tau) and A = ACTUAL first-slot MI: general NACK window is A+tau < B_tx < C+eps. The size thresholds below assume the genie-exact case A = M (raw beta-free predicted MI); under Type-II CSI A != M in general and no deterministic threshold exists. beta_m<1 (A=M): non-empty iff raw MI M < (eps-tau)/(1-beta_m), i.e. code cap C=beta_m*M < beta_m*(eps-tau)/(1-beta_m); m=1: M<54.05/C<53.05 bit, m=4: M<2.45/C<1.45 bit (tau moves the raw-M threshold by tau/(1-beta_m): 5.41e-5 bit at m=1, 2.45e-6 bit at m=4). beta=1 genie (A=M=C): NACK window M+tau < B_tx < M+eps -- swallows within tau of M still ACK on tolerance; no size threshold, (eps-tau)-wide backlog window only.
